title: claude-sub: same lease-leak and observability review for the orchestrator/review boot in run-workflow.ts
description: PR #251 fixed the lease leak on start throw and cancel for WORKER jobs (sandbox-executor.ts). run-workflow.ts (around its claudeSub lease for a review boot, ~line 1709, released ~2251) leases a subscription for the orchestrator/review container on its own path; check it for the same leak (a throw between lease and container start), and surface its step-down the same way (it already writes a note into the boot's progress line). Not covered by the review's findings list.
